name: com.brendan.hiccup
description: HTML-In-Canvas Components Unity Package. Define Unity UIs in HTML/CSS for WebGL and WebGPU builds. Uses Chrome's HTML-in-Canvas API (layoutsubtree / drawable / paint / texElementImage2D / copyElementImageToTexture) so the DOM is composited into the Unity frame while staying fully accessible (screen readers, find-in-page, text selection, IME, keyboard navigation). Falls back to a DOM overlay in browsers without the API.
